\section{Professional Summary}
\small{
Backend engineer with 6+ years of production experience in the JVM ecosystem, building scalable, high-availability services in the financial sector. At Mastercard, I designed microservices handling payment flows, tokenization, and fraud detection; built a microfrontend platform enabling independent deployment of 10+ product modules and resilience patterns across 5+ products. I care about reliability, observable systems, and continuous delivery -- backed by 95\% test coverage, circuit-breaker-protected services, and CI/CD pipelines that deploy to production with confidence. Currently completing an MSc in Advanced Computer Science at Queen Mary University of London.
